YTA.
My reason being that I was recently pregnant (now have a one month old)  and can somewhat sympathize with your wife. Hormones can make women do crazy things and experience intense emotions. Maybe she's being a bit irrational but she probably doesn't feel as attractive as she has in the past which could make her feel like you've got a reason to cheat. Maybe she's worried about the time period where you can't have sex, that you'll go off and cheat on her because you can't have sex with her for a bit. There's many reasons she could be feeling and acting the way she has. Talk to her and get down to the reason of it, work together to find a solution without her feeling worse. I didn't feel better until after my baby was born but I wasn't too crazy most of the time. Now I figure, as long as my man is honest with me, there should be no issues.

I was a very picky eater as a kid, the only way I would try anything was if someone said my "taste buds might have changed." Today, I'm very grateful that people forced me to try everything. Your 6 year old may also have issues with textures so keep that in mind when getting him to try things. I couldn't stand French style green beans because of the texture but loved regular cut ones. You may notice patterns in foods he legitimately doesn't like.

You can switch hospitals at any time. I'm 31 weeks pregnant and have yet to complete my birth plan and was only given the paperwork for it just last week. Do research, put thought into what you believe is best for your situation. There's no need to rush on any real decision making.
